newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel unchanged, demand limited.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel unchanged, demand limited.

text.p: European jet fuel was steady on Monday as stable futures combined with unchanged premiums in a thin market.
May IPE gas oil traded stable at $165.50 a tonne around 1430 GMT.
Traders said barge premiums were unchanged from the May IPE +$18.50 fob ARA that was concluded on Friday. Cargo premiums were assessed around May IPE +$24 cif NWE.
More supplies were expected as May progressed, but prices were not expected to signficantly weaken.
"We also expect increased buying, which should balance it out," said one trader.
